name: GST Registration & Returns
description: Goods and Services Tax registration, return filing, and compliance for businesses via the GST portal.
eligibility: Businesses with aggregate turnover above threshold (Rs. 20 lakh/10 lakh/40 lakh by category) or mandated (inter-state, e-commerce, casual).
benefits: Legal tax identity, input tax credit, interstate trade, compliance certificates.
application_steps: Apply Part-A (Form GST REG-01) on gst.gov.in.
Get ARN; complete Part-B with documents.
processing_time: Registration usually within 7-30 days; returns monthly/quarterly.
fees: No government registration fee; late fees for delayed returns.
office_locator_info: GST Seva Kendras / state tax offices.

faq.q: What is the GST turnover threshold?
faq.a: Generally Rs. 20 lakh (Rs. 10 lakh in special category states, Rs. 40 lakh for goods in some states).

ai_summary: GST registration and return filing portal; mandatory above turnover thresholds; input tax credit enabled.
ai_explanation: Businesses above the turnover threshold register for GST to get a GSTIN, charge tax, and claim input tax credit. Returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) are filed online. Registration is free but late returns incur fees. Aadhaar authentication is used.
